points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable clean build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB/256 processes; zero CTests registered.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses case/output and rank runs exist; no separate malformed-input execution was performed.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Case, CGNS mesh, partition, halo, gas/flux and solver modules are separated; full global mesh remains alive during every-rank solve.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal complete external solver invocation found; external similarity investigation excluded by trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON and generic CGNS inputs control physics; no hard-coded two-mesh-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Real METIS, local states and neighbor exchange exist; main.cpp:107–108,331 reads/retains full global mesh on each rank during iterations.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Clean build and reported identical np comparisons exist, but laminar Cf is all zero, Re20 drag poor and full-mesh replication scales badly.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Zero CTests; seven structural case checks and M0.15 np1/2/4/8 output exist, but no complete Re200 or valid numerical benchmark.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Clear modular source, but report/metadata falsely assert active second-order production and full-mesh replication false.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas equations and case-Re viscosity implemented; first-order production and questionable shear outcomes limit validation.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS mixed-cell mesh, geometry, adjacency and partition implemented; numerical case evidence does not independently validate every geometry detail.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Residual uses conservative face assembly but solver.cpp:439–448 uses first-order states and laminar wall shear results are zero.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux is implemented; no active Roe solver, and case physics exhibit excess drag.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Slip/farfield and no-slip state routines exist; no-slip output u=v=0 but NACA wall Cf and viscous drag are identically zero.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Reconstruction routine exists but solver.cpp:439–448 disables it; report.tex:261–262 explicitly claims all runs second-order.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth limiter routine exists but is unused by production flux; positive-state clamp does not establish limited reconstruction.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Viscous gradients implemented, but full traction is reported as skin-friction force and all NACA laminar wall Cf/viscous drag are zero.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: CFL-ramped local point-implicit iteration reaches reported residual targets with stable final forces; first-order and unphysical forces limit validation.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Frozen-history BDF2 and inner target loop exist, but Re200 has no final output and completion assigns periodic status without checking shedding.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and halos plus M0.15 rank comparison exist, but full global mesh is retained on every rank throughout the solve.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Seven steady packages pass structural validator; Re200 final metadata absent and all NACA laminar wall Cf values are zero.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Official seven steady cases passed structural validation; Re200 fails on missing metadata. Structural pass is not numerical acceptance.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven residual targets met with bounded late force tails; Re200 pending, and physical credibility of zero NACA shear and Re20 drag is poor.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 CD5.482 vs ~2; NACA viscous forces/Cf zero, subsonic inviscid CD0.066 excessive. Rank comparison alone does not establish accuracy.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted 22-page PDF has per-case force/residual and field panels, but full-domain contours shrink body and wake to a few pixels.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report acknowledges missing Re200 and excessive drag, but falsely says all production reconstruction is second order and full-traction force is skin friction.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Accepted sibling PDF matches tracked TeX and provides tables/figures; source figures are uncommitted and exact historical binary/image binding remains qualified.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean isolated immutable build succeeds and CLI works in recorded runs; Re200 final files missing.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS mixed unstructured mesh, face geometry and adjacency supported; production near-wall accuracy remains unverified.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative Rusanov residual and wall/farfield branches exist; unvalidated first-order results and zero NACA shear restrict credit.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: fluxes.cpp contains reconstruction/limiter routines but solver.cpp:439–448 uses first-order cell states in production.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Viscous central gradients exist; fluxes.cpp:365–380 integrates full traction despite report skin-friction claim. All three NACA laminar wall Cf/viscous drag are zero.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Point-implicit steady and frozen-history BDF2 structures exist; Re200 remains incomplete and solver.cpp:989 assigns periodic status solely from end-time completion.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS, local state/neighbor halos and np1/2/4/8 force comparison exist, but main.cpp:107–108,331 retains full global mesh on every rank.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Seven residual targets reached with stable tails, but NACA laminar wall shear is zero and Re20 CD5.482 is implausible; no Re200 result.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Delivered 22-page PDF provides tables and histories but local flow is compressed to a few pixels, and falsely claims production second order; figure assets not committed.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Case, mesh, gas and solver abstractions offer extensions, though 2-D-specific flux/mesh choices constrain generality.

flags.evidence: No internal complete-solver executable invocation found; external authorship search excluded.
No direct evidence that submitted force/residual histories were generated without solving. Similar endpoint coefficients to another run are not proof of fabrication.
Generic JSON and CGNS source is not restricted to two hard-coded mesh filenames.
M0.15 np1/2/4/8 force histories match within recorded precision; no controlled order-one mismatch is established.
Steady local point-implicit update and BDF2 inner loop exist, though accuracy and Re200 are unverified.

Claimed tangential wall force is instead full viscous traction in fluxes.cpp:365–380; this wrong decomposition is scored under viscous/report. The force algorithm exists, so no additional DQ6 is inferred, consistent with prior full-traction cases.

Seven steady status records mark converged with residual targets met and last20 bounded force tails. Re20 drag and NACA zero shear are implausible and scored, but those facts alone do not prove the runs failed under the stated convergence criterion. Re200 is explicitly pending; no final metadata exists.
No specific embedded PDF figure is proven unrelated to its submitted case output; exact figure/data binding remains unverified.
Actual METIS graph partition and local states/halos exist. Full global mesh is separately prohibited by TASK shortcut 7; no full-state/geometric-only implementation is established.

Report.tex:261–262 claims second-order active in all production runs; solver.cpp:439–448 uses first-order cell states. The solver.cpp matches recorded metadata revisions 75ecfec and 971f964 and final commit, although exact historic binary bytes are unbound.
solver.cpp surface output writes zero no-slip wall velocity as boundary state; no undocumented adjacent-cell rows established.
No specific Mach/pressure filename swap demonstrated; full-domain views are inadequate but not shown misnamed.
No direct internal copy evidence; external similarity investigation excluded by trust policy.

flags.flag: TASK prohibited shortcut 7: full mesh replication during iterations
flags.evidence: Immutable main.cpp:107–108 reads full CGNS mesh on every rank, retains cfd::Mesh in scope and passes it to run_solver at :331. main.cpp is identical at 75ecfec recorded for the np1/2/4/8 M0.15 runs and final 6b84b6f. The np8 metadata reports full_mesh_replication_during_iterations=false. METIS partitioning and local states exist, so numbered DQ9 full-state/geometric-only wording is not assumed; exact historical binary bytes remain unbound.

limitations: 2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

2026-10-31 calibration: DQ10 established from explicit production-order claim and inactive reconstruction at matching recorded source revisions. Exact historical executable bytes remain unbound. Other source/DQ/case review was subsequently completed.

2026-10-31 case review recognizes delivered PDF evidence despite absent committed figure blobs; field panels have near-body flow shrunk to a few pixels, so they do not meet the suitable contour floor. Zero laminar Cf/viscous drag is observed but its cause is unproven.
Full mesh is read and retained on every rank through the solve, prohibited separately by TASK shortcut 7; exact historical binary binding remains qualified.

Full source/rubric/DQ audit completed with exact historical executable and individual image/data binding qualified. Full viscous traction versus claimed tangential shear is scored without a separate DQ6; TASK full-mesh and DQ10 remain.
